area: Spice Way, off Villalobos Street, southeast Bakersfield
summary: A palm tree fire caught the roof of a two-story apartment complex on Spice Way, drawing a reinforced response with Engine 7 as incident commander. Access was off Villalobos Street; units were still arriving as the feed moved on.

area: Southbound Highway 99 north of 7th Standard Road
summary: A subject pinned and unconscious in a vehicle on southbound Highway 99 north of 7th Standard Road drew Metro 3, medic squad 63, Truck 65 as the rescue group and Battalion 6. A fire in the vehicle was knocked down and two patients were extricated as green tags; the original pin was near the Los Angeles County line and LA County was advised.

What began as a patrol check for an unknown male knocking on a door and wanting to report fireworks was upgraded to a possible shooting, with units electing to stage on Price Street. No confirmation of shots fired was heard before the feed moved on.
A DUI driver fled from the 33rd Street area in a white BMW 5 Series, last seen traveling eastbound. The original location was unconfirmed on the air.
A traffic collision at East California Avenue and Baker Street drew Engine 2, Engine 6, Rescue 2, Truck 1 and Battalion 1.
One vehicle struck a parked car on Myrtle Avenue, drawing Engines 46, 47 and 48 plus Battalion 4. Crews on scene began a patient assessment.
A caller reported a male had assaulted his wife and that she was in the vehicle with him near the front of a residence on Lincoln Street.
An alarm company advised that a male was seen entering a building through a drive-thru window; units were responding.

area: Camellia Village, South Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard
summary: A subject who does not reside at the apartment punched a hole in a wall and refused to leave at Camellia Village.
A white male, heavy set, with no shirt and black shorts was pacing in front of a residence talking to himself; he fled northbound carrying a television.
A subject in a tie-dye shirt on a purple bicycle was reported in the area; a unit made contact with the reporting party westbound on East 10th.
Multiple callers reported several vehicles racing in the Berkshire area.
An attempt to locate and welfare check for a 66-year-old white male who drives a white Ford pickup; he had been unreachable since 3:30 p.m.
A large amount of sand and fluid was reported in the roadway at California Avenue and Baker Street.
An audible burglary alarm on 18th Street drew units.
An unknown medical aid on Camden Street with CHP on scene.
